_readme: This file tells every installed copy of Hostyllo Offline 6.0.0 and later where
the control plane is. It is fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com on the MAIN
branch of mushtaqahmaduop/hostyllo-releases, at most once a day per machine,
by services/discovery.js. Editing it re-points every 6.x install without a release.
It must stay at the ROOT of the main branch of this repository. The URL is pinned
in services/discovery.js (DISCOVERY_URL), and tests/services.test.js checks it
against package.json build.publish in the source repository.
apiBase must be https and must include the /v1 prefix. /admin is for people and
must never appear here. Anything that is not valid https is REFUSED and installs
keep the address they already had.
SETTING apiBase TO null IS THE KILL SWITCH: it clears every install cache and
returns them to offline-only operation, a fully supported state.
BEFORE deleting or re-provisioning the Railway service, change this file FIRST
and give it a day: generated *.up.railway.app names are recycled.
